notes: Original volumetric (Sieverts, PCTPro with micro-doser) H2 isotherms 0-25 bar at 77 K and 298 K on five mandarin-peel-derived carbons (Fig. 7a,b; Table 4; Fig. S2a; Fig. S3 repeat isotherm). Sorbents are KOH- or APS-activated biomass carbons; EDS (Table 1) gives 91.87 at% C for M-C-KOH-4-800 and 77-98 at% C for all measured samples, so carbon is the majority component by mass. BET areas measured by the authors (N2, 77 K) for all five H2-measured samples (Table 2: 26, 1850, 1414, 2426, 566 m2/g). 'The total uptake of H2 was measured as described in previous report [28]' cites a method only; no statement that the H2 values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Table 5 and Table S1 literature values are not the paper's own measurements. Not a review; record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF.
